description: The verified behavior sheet for an API: Markdown built only from verified claims, with spec contradictions first, then sibling differences, undocumented rules, and per-endpoint behavior (error shapes, pagination, validation, auth), every line citing trial ids. Accepts a tool name, a host, or the full URL about to be called; a URL or path scopes the sheet to that endpoint plus a one-line index of the others. Brief by default (what would change the request); full=true adds per-parameter validation, response shapes and all evidence ids.

brief.description: deprecated: the default; brief=false is the same as full=true

full.description: the whole sheet: per-parameter validation, response shapes, all evidence ids

path.description: request path to scope to one endpoint, e.g. /repos/github/rest-api-description/issues; template segments match anything

tool.description: tool name (e.g. github-rest), or the host / URL you are about to call (e.g. api.github.com)

name: get_tool_docs
title: Get tool docs
